enonce_intro_markdown:
![fig-1](gce-ol-maths-2024-p2-officiel-cameroun_exercice_11_fig_1.png)

Figure 3 shows a circle with chords $AC$ and $BD$ intersecting at the centre $P$. Given that angle $DPC=86^0$, $AP=6\,\text{cm}$, $PC=12\,\text{cm}$ and $BP=8\,\text{cm}$.

figures.legende: Figure 3: circle with chords AC and BD meeting at P; AP = 6 cm, PC = 12 cm, BP = 8 cm, angle DPC = 86 degrees; angle APB marked theta; angle ADB marked beta.

incertitudes: Q11 : l'énoncé imprimé dit « intersecting at the centre P » mais P ne peut pas être le centre (AP = 6 cm différent de PC = 12 cm) : P est le point d'intersection des deux cordes. Le corrigé utilise le théorème des cordes sécantes pour PD, et la figure pour theta et beta. Beta est lu comme l'angle ADB (angle en D entre DA et DB) : 32,4 degrés (32,44), arrondi non précisé par le sujet.

questions.corrige_markdown:
Lines $AC$ and $BD$ cross at $P$. The angle $\theta=\angle APB$ is vertically opposite to $\angle DPC=86^\circ$.

Vertically opposite angles are equal.

**$\theta=86^\circ$.**

$\beta=\angle ADB=\angle ADP$.

First find $PD$ (part (c)): $PD=9$ cm. Also $\angle APD=180^\circ-86^\circ=94^\circ$ (angles on the straight line $AC$).

In triangle $APD$, use the cosine rule for $AD$:

$AD^2=6^2+9^2-2(6)(9)\cos94^\circ=117-108\cos94^\circ\approx117+7.53=124.53$, so $AD\approx11.16$ cm.

Use the sine rule: $\dfrac{\sin\beta}{AP}=\dfrac{\sin94^\circ}{AD}$, so $\sin\beta=\dfrac{6\sin94^\circ}{11.16}\approx0.5364$.

$\beta=\sin^{-1}(0.5364)\approx32.4^\circ$.

(Check: triangles $APD$ and $BPC$ are similar, since $\dfrac{AP}{BP}=\dfrac68=\dfrac34=\dfrac{PD}{PC}$ with the same included angle $94^\circ$, so $\beta=\angle ACB$; the same value $32.4^\circ$ is found.)

**$\beta\approx32.4^\circ$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) length of $PD$. *[6 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
When two chords $AC$ and $BD$ of a circle meet at $P$, $AP\times PC=BP\times PD$ (intersecting chords theorem).

$6\times12=8\times PD$, so $72=8\times PD$ and $PD=\dfrac{72}{8}=9$ cm.

**$PD=9$ cm.**
